text:
Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
Damper gear box used for 
transfer motion from motor to damper
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1,
which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the 
title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Mamdoh Anber, 
tested by eng. 
Abd El-Azeem Abdin
and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. 
Samir Abd El Gelil, accepted by general director eng. Yousry Abdel Maqsood, and 
approved by eng. Awad M. Fathay Head Sector of Talkha Power Station.
This document is updated Adel Atia tested by eng. Mahamed Abd Elaal ,accepted 
by general director eng .Mamdouh El-Saeid Andar ,approved by eng. Farouk Awad 
head sector of Talkha power plant , 
reviewed by MDEPC 
quality control eng.Magdy Hegazy ,accepted by 
eng. Samir Abd El Gelil 
MDEPC inspection and control general 
manger & MPIS. Coordinator and certified by eng. Mahmoud Nageeb .
This document is 
 updated for 5 years review .
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
Wear safety helmets, shoes
HRSG is out service.
Put damper selector on close position.
Disconnect the power supply of damper actuator 
 and tag it.
Gas turbine out of service if needed.
All safety precaution must be followed by 
 safety dep.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tools set.
Cleaning fluid 
 Manual puller.
Grease gun .
Works to be Carried Out
Drain the oil from damper gear box.
Check gears wears & damage.
Check leaking and change gasket if needed.
Change the damage parts.
Add new oil.
Grease all wires .
check damper gear box open-close .
